objective: Gate2 R3 READ_ONLY de Tablajeria. Rehacer el mapeo tecnico estructurado con required_deliverables mas deliverable_specs deterministas para materializar los 24 entregables. No construir. No mutar. No tocar Produccion. No DDL. No DML. No backend/frontend changes. No SQL definitivo. Gate3 permanece HOLD.

context.gate: Gate2 technical mapping structured READ_ONLY R3
context.previous_gate2_r2_gap: checks PASS but deliverables empty because deliverable_specs were absent
context.worker_materializer_status: R4 BOS certified: materializer works when deliverable_specs are present
context.functional_domain: Tablajeria convierte un insumo base comprado o existente en inventario en multiples derivados, cortes, subproductos, merma y desperdicio, con trazabilidad, afectacion de inventario, prorrateo de costos, compras reversivas, auditoria y futura contabilidad.

queries.name: gate2r3_tablajeria_existing_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%transform%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%produccion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producción%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%subproducto%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r3_canonical_entities_inventory_cost_purchase
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1200) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacén%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insumo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kardex%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%margen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%receta%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contab%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auditoria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r3_identity_quantity_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (1200) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON c.object_id = o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id = t.user_type_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) IN ('empresaid','unidadnegocioid','serverid','sucursalid','almacenid','productoid','insumoid','proveedorid','usuarioid') OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%operationaldate%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%cantidad%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%peso%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%unidadmedida%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, c.column_id

queries.name: gate2r3_rbac_audit_menu_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rbac%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%módulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%autoriz%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auditoria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%bitacora%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2r3_table_row_estimates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS table_name, SUM(p.rows) AS estimated_rows FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.partitions p ON o.object_id = p.object_id WHERE o.type = 'U' AND p.index_id IN (0,1) AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%') GROUP BY SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id), o.name ORDER BY schema_name, table_name

expected_result_contract.gate3_allowed: false unless all 24 deliverables are complete and evidence supports mutation readiness
expected_result_contract.work_completion: COMPLETE only if all required_deliverables materialize from deliverable_specs; otherwise PENDING_DELIVERABLES
expected_result_contract.certification: CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY only if all required deliverables are present; otherwise PENDING_DELIVERABLES
